notes: Account snapshot: product-first mid-market company building an in-app AI assistant and enterprise search for customers. Heavy on session-based chat + semantic search embeddings.
Initial approach: started on Hosted API to validate prompt flows, now wants Dedicated for predictable throughput and VPC isolation.

POC objectives (customer): prove Dedicated meets latency SLOs for interactive chat (p50 < 80ms, p95 < 220ms), support 250 concurrent sessions, embedding throughput 150 qps, and show canary + fallback behaviour across regions.
Pricing sensitivity: tight unit-cost requirements; looking for guidance from Redwood Optimize on batching/quantization to hit targets. Interested in committed discount if ARR > $250k.
Canary plan agreed (high-level):
- Week 0: Provision Dedicated pool (2x A100-equivalent nodes) in us-west-2 and eu-west-1. VPC peering and KMS key exchange.
- Week 1: Run internal traffic to Dedicated, enable continuous batching and KV cache. Smoke tests for correctness.
- Week 2: 5% canary of production traffic routed to Dedicated variant A (quantized Llama-70B-16Q) with model-variant fallback to host (hosted gpt-4o-like) on errors.
- Week 3: Ramp to 25% if p95 latency < 220ms and error_rate < 1.5% and quality metrics pass prompt evals.
- Rollback triggers defined: sustained p95 > 300ms for 10m, error_rate > 3% for 5m, regression in top-5 rouge/embedding-sim score vs baseline (auto-eval).
Fallback routing: preference order: Dedicated primary -> Hosted API regional replica -> Alternate region Dedicated pool (eu-west failover) -> degrade to best-effort cached responses.
Model variants plan: primary quantized model for cost; warm unquantized variant for low-latency critical flows; automatic fallback to more stable hosted model if quality regressions detected.
Monitoring & SLOs: will use Redwood Console for per-route p50/p95, token cost breakdown, eval-based quality alerts. Requesting 90-day retention for traces during POC.
Security notes: Infosec asked for KMS key rotation policy, HSM options, and proof of audit logging. Also asked that data residency be enforced for EU enterprise customers (needs region pinning).
Procurement: legal wants DPA updates for backups and retention; Finance requested example committed pricing vs on-demand for 12-month term.
